description: This Java source file defines an enumeration 'DittoHeaderDefinition' that specifies well-known Ditto headers, their keys, types, and validation rules, used for handling headers in the Ditto framework.

classes.name: DittoHeaderDefinition
classes.description: Enumeration of well-known Ditto headers with their key, type, validation, and external read/write flags.

methods.name: forKey
methods.description: Finds a header definition by its key, returning an Optional containing the HeaderDefinition if found.

methods.name: getJavaType
methods.description: Returns the Java class type of the header value.

methods.name: getSerializationType
methods.description: Returns the class type used for serializing the header value.

methods.name: shouldReadFromExternalHeaders
methods.description: Indicates if the header should be read from external sources.

methods.name: shouldWriteToExternalHeaders
methods.description: Indicates if the header should be written to external sources.

methods.name: validateValue
methods.description: Validates the header value using the associated validator.
